description: This file defines TypeScript types and interfaces related to the server-side context and state management of a browser automation tool, including profile handling, browser tab management, and server configuration.

methods.name: ensureBrowserAvailable
methods.description: Ensures that a browser instance is available and ready for interaction.

methods.name: ensureTabAvailable
methods.description: Ensures that a browser tab with the specified targetId is available, opening one if necessary.

methods.name: isHttpReachable
methods.description: Checks if the server is reachable over HTTP within an optional timeout.

methods.name: isReachable
methods.description: Checks if the browser is reachable within an optional timeout.

methods.name: listTabs
methods.description: Returns a list of open browser tabs.

methods.name: openTab
methods.description: Opens a new browser tab with the specified URL.

methods.name: focusTab
methods.description: Sets focus to the tab identified by targetId.

methods.name: closeTab
methods.description: Closes the tab identified by targetId.

methods.name: stopRunningBrowser
methods.description: Stops the currently running browser instance.

methods.name: resetProfile
methods.description: Resets the browser profile, optionally moving data.

methods.name: mapTabError
methods.description: Converts an error into a standard status message.

methods.name: onEnsureAttachTarget
methods.description: Optional callback invoked when ensuring a target is attached.
